Title: ServiceNow Change Request List: Build AND Filter
Description: Step-by-step workflow to construct a multi-condition AND filter on the Change Request list.
- Open the filter panel by clicking the 'Show / hide filter' button (bid a47) to reveal the filter inputs (change_requestfilterdiv).
- Select the first field from the combobox 'All of these conditions must be met. -- choose field --' (bid a1181) and choose 'Type' (option a1583).
- Set the value for 'Type' by selecting 'Normal' from the value chooser combobox (bid a1639), using select_option if clicking fails.
- Add the next condition by clicking the 'Add AND Condition To Condition 1' button (bid a1303).
- Repeat the field selection process for 'Requested by' and fill the textbox (bid a2118) with 'System Administrator'.
- Add another AND condition and select 'Model' from the field chooser (bid a2135).
- Set the Model operator to 'is empty string' using the operator combobox (bid a2579).
- Continue adding AND conditions for 'Short description' and 'State' using the 'Add AND Condition' buttons.

- 'Requested by' is a valid filter field with 'System Administrator' as a valid value (bid a2118).
- 'Model' is a valid filter field that supports the 'is empty string' operator (bid a2579).
